case_name: Jaswantrai Manilal Akhaney v. State of Bombay

pages.text:
IN THE SUPREME COURT OF INDIA
CRIMINAL APPELLATE JURISDICTION
Jaswantrai Manilal Akhaney ... Appellant
versus
State of Bombay ... Respondent
Coram: B. Jagannadhadas, B.P. Sinha, Syed Jafer Imam, JJ.
Judgment Dated: 10 April 1956

SINHA, J.:
1. The appellant, the Managing Director of the Exchange Bank of India and Africa, was charged with criminal breach of trust under Section 409 read with Section 405 of the Indian Penal Code for pledging municipal debentures entrusted by a customer for overdraft facilities.

3. Decision: The appellant had dominion over the securities and pledged them without authority to secure loans for the bank, causing wrongful risk to the customer. When property is entrusted for a specific purpose, its unauthorized appropriation constitutes criminal breach of trust under Section 405/406 IPC. Conviction upheld.
